definitions.esri_any: any source dataset name beginning with Esri
definitions.microsoft_any: any source dataset name beginning with Microsoft
definitions.openstreetmap_any: any source dataset named OSM or beginning with OpenStreetMap
definitions.other_dataset_any: any dataset name outside the Microsoft, OpenStreetMap/OSM, and Esri groups
definitions.overlap_caveat: Provider memberships overlap; only the exclusive classes form a partition.

limitations: This is a descriptive within-object sample of row groups, not a tract-level accuracy or coverage estimate; a small number of regional-object rows may not fall inside the exact official tract sample.
Source attribution does not establish geometric equality, completeness, reference vintage, or which provider uniquely contributed each geometry.
Row-group sampling uncertainty and spatial clustering are not modelled; the selected groups and fixed seeds are published for reproduction.
method: Deterministic regional row-group sample of provided Overture building sources metadata

eastern-ok.sample_design: all row groups are sampling strata; within each group, simple random sample without replacement of ceil(10% of records), using a deterministic region/group-specific seed

maricopa-az.sample_design: all row groups are sampling strata; within each group, simple random sample without replacement of ceil(10% of records), using a deterministic region/group-specific seed

northern-ca.sample_design: all row groups are sampling strata; within each group, simple random sample without replacement of ceil(10% of records), using a deterministic region/group-specific seed

south-central-tx.sample_design: all row groups are sampling strata; within each group, simple random sample without replacement of ceil(10% of records), using a deterministic region/group-specific seed

sampling.seed_rule: BASE_SEED plus the low four bytes of SHA-256(region:row_group_index)

scope: The sampling frame is each region-specific provided Overture buildings object; no bbox, geometry, or exact official-tract assignment is read.
